name: planning

surface.title: Interview question surface
surface.description: Where /planning:interview renders its question rounds: terminal (default, inline in the conversation) or page (a local 127.0.0.1 page the session watches, where each question is answered and every save reaches the session). Applies only to /planning:interview.

use_ask_user_question.title: AskUserQuestion question rounds
use_ask_user_question.description: When enabled, the planning skills' question rounds (interview, prd, design, plan) render a round of independent questions that fits one AskUserQuestion call instead of inline prose. Default: inline prose (dictation-friendly).

use_emoji_question_markers.title: Interview question emoji anchors
use_emoji_question_markers.description: When on, each interview round question leads with a ❓ anchor on its Q<N> line and its My recommendation line leads with ➡️, in the terminal and on the page surface. Purely presentational: persisted artifacts never carry the emoji. Default: plain text.

shared_session_open_browser.title: Open the shared interview page
shared_session_open_browser.description: When on, starting a /planning:interview shared session opens the owner's page in the default browser. Turn off to open it yourself. Default: on.

tunnel_hostname.title: Shared interview tunnel hostname
tunnel_hostname.description: Hostname of a named Cloudflare tunnel for /planning:interview shared sessions (such as interview.example.com), so the guest link survives a restart. Set it on one machine only. Empty (default): a quick tunnel, whose link changes on restart. Setup: shared/README.md.

tunnel_token_file.title: Shared interview tunnel token file
tunnel_token_file.description: Absolute path of a file holding the named tunnel's token, readable only by you; cloudflared reads it, nothing else does. Used only when tunnel_hostname is set. Default: empty.

plan_store.title: Plan store
plan_store.description: Where /planning:plan keeps an approved plan: local (default, PLAN.md in the memory slice only) or tracker (also posted as one comment on the claimed work item). A repository's docs/conventions/planning.yaml plan_store key overrides this value.

phase_order.title: Phase order
phase_order.description: How /planning:plan orders phases: composed (default: dead-code removal, integration slice, riskiest unknown, scaffold, features), subtraction-first (removal, scaffold, features) or riskiest-first. A repository's docs/conventions/planning.yaml phase_order key overrides this value.

scaffold_stubs.title: Stub scaffold commit
scaffold_stubs.description: When on, /planning:design hands off the stub files and signatures a change needs, and /planning:plan puts one stub phase right after dead-code removal (first when there is none). Default: off. A repository's docs/conventions/planning.yaml scaffold_stubs key overrides this value.

time_units.title: Time units in estimates
time_units.description: When on, the planning skills may state an estimate or budget of work in hours, days or weeks; when off they use the work_size levels instead. Practice cadence and measurement windows are not affected. Default: off. A repository's docs/conventions/planning.yaml time_units key overrides this value.

description: Pre-implementation planning pipeline: chart a too-big, foggy effort as a decision map, diverge on candidate approaches, lock product intent and the engineering contract, route resolved domain language to the domain-driven-design glossary steward, explore the design space, stress-test adversarially, and produce a structured implementation plan with an approval gate, with an opt-in multi-angle plan panel workflow (/planning:plan-panel).
